panels.art: High-angle shot over Dan's shoulder at a cluttered drafting desk at 2 AM. His phone lights his tired face from below; the screen shows a long stack of missed calls (vermilion text added in lettering pass). Cold green-grey fluorescent light, sodium-orange city glow in the window behind.

lines.ru: 02:07 ночи. Сегодня у мамы день рождения. Дэн обещал позвонить вечером. Он сидит над чужим чертежом, а телефон показывает девять пропущенных.
Девять звонков. И все от мамы.
lines.delivery: exhausted and guilty, almost whispering to himself at 2 AM in an empty office

panels.art: Extreme close-up of the phone screen held in Dan's hand, a short text message from Mom (lettering added later), a coffee ring on the desk beneath. Behind, out of focus, a rolled drawing of a bridge pinned over the monitor.

lines.delivery: soft, tired and warm, like a mother's gentle text read aloud in the quiet night
hushed, heavy with guilt, voice cracking a little on the last word

lines.ru: Она даже не сердится — и от этого хуже. Дэн чертит чужие здания. Его собственный мост лежит в ящике с шестнадцати лет.

panels.art: Low-angle wide shot: behind Dan's desk the plain grey wall now holds a tall black wooden door that was never there, a faint vermilion glow leaking around its edges. Dan, small in the foreground, turns with a coffee mug in his hand.

lines.ru: Три года Дэн знает эту стену. Он сам чертил этот этаж. Двери здесь быть не может.

lines.en: I know this wall. There is no door.
lines.ru: Я знаю эту стену. Здесь нет двери.
lines.delivery: low, wary and disbelieving, speaking slowly as an engineer who knows his own office walls

panels.art: Insert shot: an old brass door handle in close-up, glowing vermilion letters crawl across the black wood like cracks of light (lettering added later). Tiny dust motes float in the glow.

lines.ru: На ручке горит красное слово. Дэн читает его — «OPEN». Оно слабо пульсирует, будто дышит.

lines.en: A word on a door? What is that?
lines.delivery: baffled whisper, leaning closer, curious and uneasy at the glowing letters

panels.art: Close-up on Dan's wide eyes behind taped glasses, phone ringing in his raised hand, the black door in soft focus behind him with ripples spreading through its wood from three knocks.

lines.ru: Стук. Изнутри. Три раза, ровно. Телефон в руке звонит в такт.

lines.delivery: nervous and quiet, calling out toward a strange door with a shaky voice
hurried, apologetic, speaking into the ringing phone while distracted by the door

panels.art: Medium shot: the black door swings inward by itself, white light spilling over Dan's face and glasses; he leans back, one foot already stepping forward. His long shadow stretches behind him across the office.

lines.delivery: startled, breathless, voice jumping up in disbelief as the door swings open

lines.en: I am tired. This is a dream.
lines.delivery: weary self-reassurance, forced calm that does not quite convince him

lines.ru: Он знает, что туда нельзя. Он идёт. За дверью — свет, а здесь у него только остывший кофе.

panels.art: Full-bleed white-out. Dan's small silhouette tumbling through light, arms flung wide; his phone slips from his fingers and spins away, its screen a tiny glowing rectangle shrinking into the white.

lines.ru: Свет. Пол уходит из-под ног. Телефон выскальзывает из руки и летит вниз, в белизну.

lines.delivery: desperate panicked shout, falling through light, reaching for his mother's call

panels.art: Extreme low-angle establishing shot: Dan, tiny, sprawled on a stone plaza at dusk; the colossal bone-white Tower rises endlessly through cream clouds above him. Thousands of small vermilion letters drift upward like lanterns against an apricot-to-grey-teal sky.

lines.ru: Дэн лежит на холодных плитах. Над ним — Башня, она уходит выше облаков. Вверх плывут красные огоньки. Это не огни. Это слова.

lines.delivery: dazed, small and awed, breathless wonder mixed with fear under a giant tower

panels.art: Medium shot: a floating cream-paper System window with a vermilion double border hovers beside Dan's face; his glasses reflect vermilion light. The window is slightly tilted and casts a soft shadow.

lines.delivery: bright polite game-system greeting with a faint hollow, ominous edge
flat cold announcement, a blunt number delivered without pity

lines.ru: Башня переводит Дэну — но только короткими фразами. Чем больше слов он освоит, тем длиннее будут фразы. Но слово здесь — не просто звук. Освоенное слово даёт силу.

panels.art: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the System window: Dan jabs an indignant finger at it, the window floats there blank and unbothered. Plaza stones and the Tower's base blur behind.

lines.delivery: indignant and confused, tired man arguing with a floating window, comic annoyance

lines.en: Words are power. You are weak.
lines.delivery: deadpan cold verdict, matter of fact and quietly mocking

lines.en: I am not weak! I am tired.
lines.delivery: defensive and a bit petulant, stung pride under exhaustion
dry flat pronouncement, short and merciless, with a hint of mockery

panels.art: Wide shot: Dan turns to the spot where he landed; the plaza wall behind him is blank stone, no door. He spreads his hands, baffled. The System window floats at the edge of frame, a small tilted rectangle.

lines.delivery: worried, searching, voice rising as he looks around the empty wall
short cold statement, no sympathy, a single blunt fact
hopeful and fragile, asking quietly, afraid of the answer

lines.en: Find the last door. Some doors go home.
lines.ru: Найди последнюю дверь. Некоторые двери ведут домой.
lines.delivery: calm mysterious system voice, ceremonial and slightly cryptic

panels.art: Wide shot of a narrow soot-brown stone corridor lined with torn paper pages, cold teal darkness at its far end. Dan stands small in the foreground clutching his lanyard; beside him a rusted iron hatch in the wall. Faint claw-scratches echo (visual: tiny dust shaking from the ceiling).

lines.ru: Площадь кончается коридором. В темноте скребутся чьи-то когти. Рядом в стене — ржавый люк. Дэн замечает заклёпки и петли: люк точно открывается.

lines.delivery: loud, hoarse and awkward, shouting an order at a stuck hatch, half hoping it works

panels.art: Close-up of Dan's mouth and raised hand: glowing vermilion lettering pours out of his lips and slams into the rusted hatch, which bursts open in a shower of rust flakes. Dan's face is lit vermilion, shocked and delighted.

lines.delivery: amazed, giddy and breathless, laughing in disbelief that it worked
crisp flat system notification, precise and neutral
crisp flat counter readout, bored precision

panels.art: Medium two-shot: Mira steps out of the dark behind Dan, a rope coil on her shoulder, vermilion cord on her wrist, one eyebrow raised, deadpan. Dan jumps. The open hatch yawns black beside them.

lines.delivery: deadpan, low, unimpressed, barely moving her lips, a cold warning
quiet and grim, cold matter-of-fact survival rule
wary and startled, suspicious, asking a stranger in the dark
curt and guarded, giving her name as if it costs her something

panels.art: Over-the-shoulder from Mira's side: Dan pleading with open hands, Mira stares past him, uninterested; behind him a pool of teal shadow quietly spreads across the floor.

lines.delivery: pleading and desperate, hands open, voice breaking, begging a stranger for help
cold, dismissive and bored, turning away without looking at him
panicked, raw and louder, near tears, begging a second time

lines.ru: Мира смотрит не на Дэна. Она смотрит ему за спину. Тень на полу растёт.

panels.art: Dramatic low-angle: a tall Silent rises from the teal shadow behind Dan, its blank bone-white face with a single vertical teal seam for a mouth; Mira already half-turned to bolt, Dan frozen mid-turn, glasses catching the light.

lines.delivery: low urgent whisper, tight with fear, naming the danger in the shadows

lines.en: Who is that? What is a Silent?
lines.delivery: frightened and confused, rapid questions with a shaky breath
sharp commanding shout, urgent and breathless, giving a life-or-death order

panels.art: Dynamic wide diagonal shot: Dan and Mira sprint down the corridor between lantern-words; Dan stumbles behind, gasping, glasses askew; Mira drags him by the sleeve. Far behind them the Silent just walks, never closer, never farther.

lines.en: I am slow! I am so tired!
lines.delivery: gasping and wheezing while sprinting, panicked and self-mocking

lines.en: You are slow. Run, run, run!
lines.ru: Да, ты медленный. Беги, беги, беги!
lines.delivery: sharp and impatient, breathless, barking encouragement while running
flat and cold, a dry judgment delivered over the chase, faintly amused

panels.art: Wordless close-up: the Silent's smooth face inches from the viewer, a reflection of Dan's frightened face in the dark; the teal mouth-seam begins to open.

lines.ru: Дэн падает. Дыхания нет. Безмолвные берут слова у тех, кто выдохся. Существо наклоняется — вместо рта у него щель.

lines.delivery: hollow breathy whisper, imitating Dan's voice slightly wrong, eerie and smooth
cold final system notice, quiet and chilling, almost gentle

lines.ru: Дэн открывает рот. Имени там больше нет. А у существа — его голос.

grammarNote.title: Глагол to be: am / is / are
grammarNote.body: В английском нельзя пропустить глагол: «Я Дэн» — это «I am Dan». Для «я» ставим am, для «ты» (а ещё «мы», «они») — are, а для «он / она / оно / это» — is. Вопрос получается перестановкой: «Who are you?». Отрицание — просто not после глагола: «I am not weak». Слово, которое нужно назвать как слово, пишем ЗАГЛАВНЫМИ: OPEN.

quiz.q: Почему Дэн не позвонил маме вовремя?
Что Система сказала Дэну про его слова?
Какое слово сработало на ржавом люке?
Что Безмолвный забрал у Дэна в конце?
